rows.grounds: nominative singular subject with fused tatra and api
middle voice present of root lī

items.question: How does the all-self become directly perceived when bhāva dissolves through many bhāvas?
items.inference: Dissolution of bhāva through many bhāvas leads to direct perception of all-self.
uncertainties: Exact referent of bhāva and tatra remains context-dependent.
items.plain_english: By many kinds of bhāvas, indeed, the bhāva there too dissolves.
